author: Ogrey
body:
Before typing anything else, I'd just like to say a big THANK YOU to ILLEGAL for this fantastic theme that has inspired me to make this :)

Hello Avicadians! Me and my cutie Meowfrees have built a Nebula TDM map for you guys!
Thanks for being awesome :)

Map Creators: Evocal & Meowfrees
Map Name: Illegal Office
Map Download: Not yet
Map Info:
- Nebula TDM (Team Deathmatch)
- Team Red (Redmond) vs Team Blue (Blutarch)
- 25 vs 25
